CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: a surgical procedure that resurfaces a localized area of damaged knee cartilage and underlying subchondral bone using a metal or metal-polyethylene implant, typically in a focal region of the knee (e.g., femoral condyle).
blocks.section_title: CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: a radiographic grading system describing osteoarthritic changes to the tibial-femoral joint of the knee. When used, the radiographic findings on plain x-rays are typically reported within one of the following categories:
blocks.section_title: CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: Grade I: doubtful narrowing of joint space and possible osteophytic lipping
blocks.section_title: CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: Grade II: definite osteophytes and possible narrowing of joint space
blocks.section_title: CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: Grade III: moderate multiple osteophytes, definite narrowing of joint space, some sclerosis, and possible deformity of bone contour
blocks.section_title: CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: Grade IV: large osteophytes, marked narrowing of joint space, severe sclerosis, and definite deformity of bone contour
blocks.section_title: CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: a surgical procedure aimed at restoring knee function due to damaged bone/cartilage by replacing, resurfacing, or realigning the articular surfaces of the knee joint (partial or total). Arthroplasty is a broad term that includes various techniques, such as partial resurfacing, compartmental replacement, or total joint replacement.
blocks.section_title: CMM.JT.DF.311

blocks.text: a specific type of knee arthroplasty involving prosthetic replacement of knee compartments. When the medial and lateral compartments are replaced (with or without patellar resurfacing), it is termed total knee replacement/total knee arthroplasty; when one compartment is replaced, it is termed partial or unicompartmental knee replacement.

blocks.text: Isolated polyethylene liner exchange (IPE) is considered medically necessary for ANY of the following post-operative conditions when ALL of the associated criteria have been met:
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: eccentric polyethylene wear and osteolysis with imaging studies confirming BOTH of the following findings:
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: progressive osteolysis
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: well-fixed implants in acceptable position
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: catastrophic polyethylene failure, (includes post fracture, locking mechanism failure, or severe polyethylene wear) without component loosening or malalignment
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: acute post-operative joint infection (periprosthetic or hematogenous) with well-fixed implants
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: stiffness following total knee replacement (flexion contracture >15° with flexion limited to <90°) with BOTH of the following:
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: individual presents later than three (3) months from the index replacement procedure
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: persistent restricted range of motion despite BOTH of the following treatments:
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: physical therapy
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: manipulation under anesthesia
blocks.section_title: Isolated Polyethylene Liner Exchange (IPE) Indications

blocks.text: instability without component malrotation or malalignment
